en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, grand hotel complex set on a forested hillside above a town. The central building is multi‑storied with towers at each end and a steep, mansard‑style roof, surrounded by smaller villas and lush trees. At the bottom center of the image, handwritten‑style text reads "Karlsbad. Hotel Imperial". The scene suggests an early–20th‑century spa resort in a mountainous area.
